## Core Capabilities (v3.0)
- **Full Street 0–4 Flat-Play Solver**: Evaluates candidate placements by true 1-on-1 Net EV (accounting for opponent counter-Fantasyland), Fantasyland tier probabilities (QQ / KK / AA / Trips), and Foul %.
- **100% Offline iOS Engine**: Native C++20 neural nets + exact branch-and-bound FL & endgame enumeration with zero server latency; works on flights and in live poker rooms. Browser Web App runs quantized neural-net weights locally in a WebWorker.
- **Deck Rules**: Supports both **54-card (2 Jokers)** with legal Joker downgrade rules and **52-card (No Jokers)**.
- **Effective Stack Presets**: 1-tap switching across **50pt, 100pt, 200pt, and ∞ (infinite)** effective stacks with dedicated 1-on-1 Fantasyland EV tables.
- **AI Full-Hand Review**: Grades every street (S0–S4) after a battle with Accuracy %, total EV loss, blunder highlights, and instant spot replay.
- **Exact Fantasyland Solver (14–17 cards)**: Branch-and-bound optimal placement with 4×13 suited card keyboard.
- **Free Daily Spot & Curated Pro Drills**: Solver-mined spots across Basic, Standard, and Master tiers plus automatic mistake review.

## Verified 1-on-1 (Heads-Up) Fantasyland EV Benchmarks (v3.0 — Accounting for Opponent Counter-FL & Stack Caps)
Unlike one-sided "own FL chain only" figures (which ignore the opponent entering Fantasyland back from flat play), OFC Optimizer v3.0 solves the true 1-on-1 equilibrium net value of entering Fantasyland (same-card Re-Fantasy: Top Trips or Bottom Quads+ only):

### 54-Card (2 Jokers) by Effective Stack
- QQ (14 cards): ∞ 3.3pt (±0.4) | 200pt 3.6pt | 100pt 4.5pt | 50pt 6.0pt (+83% — shallow caps shield against opponent counter-FL)
- KK (15 cards): ∞ 14.0pt (±0.6) | 200pt 14.1pt | 100pt 14.3pt | 50pt 13.5pt (-3%)
- AA (16 cards): ∞ 35.2pt (±0.8) | 200pt 34.5pt | 100pt 30.3pt | 50pt 23.2pt (-34%)
- Trips (17 cards): ∞ 80.9pt (±2.5) | 200pt 69.3pt | 100pt 51.1pt | 50pt 33.1pt (-59%)

### 52-Card (No Jokers) by Effective Stack
- QQ (14 cards): ∞ 8.2pt (±0.2) | 200pt 8.2pt | 100pt 8.4pt | 50pt 8.5pt (higher than 54c QQ because opponents rarely counter-FL without Jokers)
- KK (15 cards): ∞ 14.6pt (±0.3) | 200pt 14.7pt | 100pt 14.7pt | 50pt 14.3pt
- AA (16 cards): ∞ 25.2pt (±0.4) | 200pt 25.2pt | 100pt 24.8pt | 50pt 21.8pt (-13%)
- Trips (17 cards): ∞ 45.9pt (±1.0) | 200pt 45.4pt | 100pt 40.9pt | 50pt 30.6pt (-33%)
